limits: Static source declarations: every CMake branch is combined; this is not the configured File API graph of one preset
Link edges are target_link_libraries declarations; include edges are literal includes resolved to an owning module
Python imports are a literal AST scan; dynamic imports, native initialization and external packages' imports are not proven
Package outputs are the build's declarations, not an installed tree; installed provenance is checked by the package gates
The record is of the working tree named by head and worktree_changes, not of a clean commit unless worktree_changes is empty

cmake/Install.cmake: TARGETS ${_fsim_export_targets} EXPORT fsimTargets RUNTIME DESTINATION bin COMPONENT sdk LIBRARY DESTINATION lib COMPONENT sdk ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib COMPONENT sdk

CODE execute_process(COMMAND \"${CMAKE_COMMAND}\" \"-DSRC=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/aircraft\"
                                  \"-DDEST=\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/flightsim/aircraft\"
                                  -P \"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/StageDesigns.cmake\"
                                  RESULT_VARIABLE _fsim_stage_result)
                  if(NOT _fsim_stage_result EQUAL 0)
                      message(FATAL_ERROR \"Aircraft runtime data staging failed\")
                  endif() COMPONENT ${component}
FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/jsbsim/COPYING DESTINATION share/doc/flightsim RENAME LICENSE-JSBSim.txt COMPONENT ${component} OPTIONAL
TARGETS ${_fsim_viewer_targets} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin COMPONENT viewer
FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/config/maps.README.md DESTINATION maps RENAME README.md COMPONENT viewer
CODE message(WARNING \"assets/maps is empty - run fetch-maps.cmd, or the package has no terrain\") COMPONENT viewer
TARGETS flightsim RUNTIME DESTINATION bin COMPONENT tools
TARGETS ${_fsim_example_targets} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin COMPONENT examples
EXPORT fsimTargets NAMESPACE fsim:: DESTINATION lib/cmake/fsim COMPONENT sdk
python/CMakeLists.txt: DIRECTORY ${FSIM_PY_PACKAGE} DESTINATION . COMPONENT python PATTERN __pycache__ EXCLUDE

CODE execute_process(COMMAND \"${FSIM_PYTHON}\" \"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/make_wheel.py\"
                                      \"\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/fsim\" \"${PROJECT_VERSION}\" \"\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}\"
                              RESULT_VARIABLE _rc)
              if(NOT _rc EQUAL 0)
                  message(FATAL_ERROR \"python: the wheel could not be built\")
              endif() COMPONENT python
